hook.name: UniHooks Shared Hook
hook.description: A single shared hook managing configurable token launch rules per pool, including anti-snipe windows, burn, LP rewards, treasury fees, sell tax, allowlist, wallet cap, same-block trading guard, liquidity lock, volatility fees, and sandwich guard. Rules are immutably fixed at pool creation via createPool, with a 0.10% platform fee on every swap taken in the paired token.
